g.text: Bit-Exact Architecture of the 8-Word Modular Addition & Multi-Stride Rotational Diffusion Layer

svg.text: PASS 1: Stride 1 (Adjacent Pairs: W_i += W_{i+1}) & ROTL 7
PASS 2: Stride 2 (Cross Pairs: W_i += W_{i+2}) & ROTL 11
PASS 3: Stride 4 (Wide Pairs: W_i += W_{i+4}) & ROTL 13

g.text: ⊞ Modular Addition: W_i = (W_i + W_j) mod 2³² (ARX non-linear diffusion)
⋘ Bitwise Left Rotation: Circular shift by 7, 11, or 13 bits
Cross-Word Injection Wire: Source word tapped without mutation
• Elimination of S-Boxes: The initial draft sketched placeholder [S] boxes.
In the hardened implementation, S-boxes were omitted in favor of pure ARX
operations to eliminate table-lookup cache timing side-channels.
• Accurate Wire Topologies: The hand-drawn draft missed connections in
Pass 2 and Pass 3. This diagram strictly reflects the exact C++ and Python
